updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-28 2241
updates.notes:
New: The title screen tells you when an update is out, with an UPDATE button
New: WHAT'S NEW screen: read the patch notes, then update now or later
New: After updating, WHAT'S NEW shows once so you can see what changed
Change: Online play asks you to update first when your game is out of date (offline modes still work)
Change: Music volume evened out across all songs

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-29 1632
updates.notes:
Change: After your point character is KO'd, the next character waits about 1.5 seconds before jumping in (it was instant in 2-character teams)
Fix: In 2-character teams the next character now enters from a random side after a KO, like in 3-character teams., and holds back until the opponent's attack is over (5 seconds at most).
New: CVS characters now have their own move lists in the pause Command List (CVS characters showed no list or the wrong one before)
Change: In CVS style the pause screen no longer shows the MVC super inputs; check Command List for each character's supers
Change: Removed the small animated avatar from the bottom left of the title screen
Fix: Command List inputs now line up with their move names
Fix: Command List shows 'any punch' (P) and 'any two punches' (P+P) instead of one specific button, EX versions get their own row, and Custom Combo shows as Down + Tag on one row
Change: Command List shows double motions as two motion icons (QCF QCF) and uses the 2-punch / 3-punch (and kick) icons
Change: Bardock's supers now deal standard damage: level 1 about 160, level 2 about 240, level 3 about 360 (Air Riot Javelin, Heat Phalanx, Super Riot Javelin, MAX Heat Phalanx, Final Spirit Cannon and Rebellion Trigger were doing up to 750)
Change: Super BG is now set separately for each style: MVC uses the MvC2 background, CVS uses Blend (change either in Options while that style is on)
Fix: With Random Battle on, a rematch could give the same character on both teams the same colour; mirror picks now always get different colours

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-29 2014
updates.notes:
Change: Tournament bracket has the new TagWars look (black, white and red, like the select and VS screens). The current match glows blue and red, players who lost are greyed out, and the countdown no longer covers the title.
Change: Tournament Rules and player name screens have the new TagWars look too, with a bracket preview and a list of players as names are entered.
Fix: Losing a Fury Rush at 10% life or less on a stage with wall breaks blows the fighter apart at the wall again (it went through the wall instead).
Change: Training mode: the Hyper Drive gauge stays full, so Hyper Drive is always ready (it refills as soon as it ends).
Fix: Hyper Drive cancels into charge moves (like Guile's Sonic Boom and Flash Kick) only need a tap of back-forward or down-up now, not a full charge. This now works for every CVS charge character (Guile, Blanka, Chun-Li, Leona, Ralf, Ash, Urien, Q and the rest).
Fix: Online lobby has a JOIN A ROOM option again. Pick it (or press Right) to move to the room list, then pick a room to join.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-30 1948
updates.notes:
Change: Fury Rush now has its own setting in CVS style, Off by default. Change it in CVS style under Extra Settings > Battle Rules > Clash. MVC style keeps its own setting.
New: The host picks the rounds to win when making an online room or using Host Game, and both players fight with that number.
Fix: Online players with different round settings no longer get different rounds to win.
Fix: Holding B on the online character select screen now leaves the match when the bar fills up.
Fix: LB is now Tag and Assist, and LT is now Variable Cross and Snapback, matching the TAG and Drive rows in Joystick Config. Saved button setups do not need changing.
Fix: Snapback now only works in neutral or as a cancel from an attack that hit, not during hitstun or blockstun.
New: The stage select screen has a new look. Each stage plays a live preview behind the bars, with its name and a row of stage thumbnails.
New: Ancient Tower Chasm can now send the fight three ways. Break the left wall to fall to On The Hilltop At Night, break the right wall to fall to Death Valley (Starry), or crack the glass floor with hard knockdowns until the third one shatters it and drops you to The Chaos Dimension. Offline only.
New: Helvetian Lake, On The Hilltop At Night, The Chaos Dimension, Death Valley (Starry) and Gouken's Temple At Night are now linked through their walls. Offline only.
Fix: In CVS style, fighters no longer air dash in after a stage transition. They run or dash in on the ground, or join directly during a fall.
Change: Default life is now 100, and a single fighter against a team now has 80 life.
Change: Stage select is now available in one more game mode.
Change: SPAR, Evil Ryu, Oswald and Rozwel adjustments, including lower damage on one of SPAR's specials.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-30 2008
updates.notes:
Change: The UPDATE item on the title screen now always shows, so you can read the patch notes any time.
Fix: The conch on the WHAT'S NEW screen is no longer cut off.
Fix: The GOING BACK card now shows on top of the WHAT'S NEW screen while holding B.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-30 2013
updates.notes:
Change: The UPDATE item on the title screen now always shows, so you can read the patch notes any time.
Fix: The conch on the WHAT'S NEW screen is no longer cut off.
Fix: The GOING BACK card now shows on top of the WHAT'S NEW screen while holding B.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-30 2104
updates.notes:
Change: CVS music is now evened out, so songs play at about the same volume.
Fix: Majin Vegeta's level 3 (Saiyan Pride Beat-Down) now plays out in full instead of stopping after the grab.
Fix: CVS Daimon can now cancel his Jiraishin, Chou Ukemi roll and grabs into other specials in Hyper Drive and with Drive Cancels, like in KOF XIII.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-30 2219
updates.notes:
Change: CVS Twelve's commands now follow SF3 3rd Strike: N.D.L. QCF+P, A.X.E. QCB+P (ground and air), D.R.A. air QCB+K, Kokkuu air dash on forward-forward or back-back, B.M.K. on forward+MK. EX moves use the same motions with two buttons, and supers use TagWars level buttons.
Fix: CVS Twelve's N.D.L. strength now follows the button pressed.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-31 1630
updates.notes:
Change: CVS Vice: throws do less damage (139 to 80).
Change: CVS Vice: Mayhem does 60 damage at every strength, with less chip damage. Opponents fall faster and can recover sooner.
Change: CVS Vice: Outrage, EX Outrage and Ravenous do less damage and chip damage.
Fix: Typing a name in Options no longer backs out when you press a letter mapped to a menu button, like B. Esc or B on a controller still cancels.
Change: Asura Rugal has been removed from the CVS roster.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-31 1655
updates.notes: Fix: Fresh installs no longer show as OTHER VERSION in the online lobby when on the same update.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-10-31 2329
updates.notes:
Change: The SFvsMK stage no longer comes up in online matches. It's still playable offline.
Fix: The SFvsMK stage no longer saves its fatality counts during matches, which could make players on the same update show as a different version.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-02 1714
updates.notes:
Change: CVS normal grabs now do 80 damage in total (grapplers like Zangief, Hugo and T.Hawk do 100). Multi-hit grabs split the 80 across their hits.
Change: Sky Chase is now its own mechanic for every team (no longer Baroque / Infinity Stones only). It is off by default: turn it on in Extra Settings > Battle Rules > Other Rules. It is always off in online matches.
Change: CVS Chang, Kairi and Superman: frame data changes and hitbox / hurtbox adjustments.
New: Groundwork for TagWars X2L, a lighter version for lower-end PCs. X2 now carries the X2L select screen (2 rows of 16) and its stage list (6 stages per side) so X2 and X2L players can play each other: online, if either player is on X2L, both get the X2L screen, roster and stages, and the Online Lobby lists X2 and X2L rooms for each other. Nothing changes for X2 players yet.
Fix: Start (random) now picks a random character on the X2L select screen, which has no Random box.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-02 1804
updates.notes: Change: TagWars X2L is now about 2.5 GB instead of 4.1 GB: it keeps only the stages, music and stage previews it uses. Older X2L copies remove the unused files by themselves the next time they start through TagWars X2L Launcher.bat.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-02 2052
updates.notes:
New: CVS style adds 3 characters - Saiki, Maylee and Shun'Ei.
Fix: Maylee and Shun'Ei no longer play themselves - their built-in AI only runs when the CPU controls them.
Change: Saiki, Maylee and Shun'Ei throws do 80 damage; their supers do 160 (level 1), 240 (level 2) and 360 (level 3).
New: Command Lists for Saiki, Maylee and Shun'Ei in the pause menu.
Change: X2 and X2L can still play each other online when X2 gets characters X2L doesn't have. Both PCs need this update first.
Change: Wild Punish is now Off by default (Extra Settings).
Change: CVS Ash takes a little more damage after being knocked down.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-02 2056
updates.notes: Fix: Wild Punish is now really Off by default, offline and online (the last update only listed the change). If you saved your Extra Settings before, check Wild Punish there.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-02 2241
updates.notes:
New: Going online without a profile now shows how to make one (hold B to close), then opens the lobby with PROFILE ready. Host Game and Join Game go to the lobby too until you have a profile.
Change: Saving a control profile now also plays as it right away, so its name shows online without loading it again.
Change: Lobby: CHANGE PROFILE is now PROFILE, with Key Config, Joystick Config and Control Profiles (Load / Save / Delete) inside. A opens it, a tap of B closes it, holding B still leaves the lobby.
Fix: The lobby's No profiles yet message pointed to a menu that no longer exists.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-03 0030
updates.notes:
Change: Ranking screen remade in the TagWars look (rank medals, team faces, your new record glows blue)
New: Ranking names can be your full name (up to 12 letters); on a profile your name is saved for you, no typing
Change: Start screen remade in the TagWars look (new logo, Battle of the Minds, conch by the prompt)
New: ARCADE on the title screen - Tag team run of 10 fights with 2 minigames (Sudden Death, Throws Only); debug keys are off during a run and cheated runs aren't ranked

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-03 1745
updates.notes:
New: the ONLINE LOBBY has a PLAYERS tab (LB / RB switches between Rooms and Players): see everyone who has TagWars X2 open, what they are doing, where they are from and whether they play X2 or X2L. ONLINE SETTINGS in the lobby: Appear Offline, who can challenge you, your region. Hold A on a player to CHALLENGE them: they get a NEW CHALLENGER pop-up in the menus, and accepting starts an online match right away - no room hunting, no port forwarding. Players in Arcade or an online match are busy. Friends come next.
New: warning and ARE YOU SURE messages (profiles, Options, key config) use the new TagWars card look, and yes/no questions start on the safe choice.
New: the online Waiting for player 2 and connecting screens and the room PLAY / WATCH choice use the new TagWars look. Challenges are now Hold A, so nobody gets challenged by accident.
New: a challenge that arrives during a local fight shows a strip at the bottom: hold Start to join or Back to decline, or pause to answer. When the match ends it takes the Rematch spot: hold A to join, hold B to decline.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-03 1825
updates.notes:
New: Stage Select shows which stages have stage transitions: a TRANSITIONS tag, plus a panel with where each wall leads and how to break through.
New: the title screen shows how many players are online right now, next to the version.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-03 2255
updates.notes:
Change: Extra Settings cleanup: Break, Limb Damage, Torso Damage, Wild Punish, Physics, Super Win FX, Hyper Win FX and Match Results are removed (always Off).
Change: Counter FX, Counter Text, Combo Text, Break Text and Parry FX are now Off by default. Your setting was reset to Off; turn them back on in Visuals > Effects if you want them.
Change: CVS: Chains, Super Jump, Air Dash and Guard Push are now Off by default. Your setting was reset to Off; turn them back on in Extra Settings > CVS if you want them.
Change: Super Moves > Zoom now only works in CVS. MVC characters use their own super zoom.
Change: Wild Counter is back to its original timing: the special has to come out right as you recover from a hit, block or get-up, and up close. Holding back to block no longer counts.
Change: CVS Maylee, Saiki and Shun'Ei tuned to match the rest of the CVS cast: 3-level super gauge, standard life and defence, normal walk and run speeds, and more of their attacks can be blocked in the air.
Change: CVS Saiki: lower damage on his normals and specials, updated hitboxes and button inputs.
Change: CVS Maylee: updated button inputs and animations.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-04 1922
updates.notes:
New: Casey Jones (from TMNT x Justice League Turbo) joins the CVS roster. He keeps his original moves and weapon swaps, and now has a full six-button set of normals (light, medium and heavy, standing, crouching and in the air). Specials: HP or HK gives the heavy version, the other buttons the light one. EX specials use two punches or two kicks and cost 1/2 bar. Super Drop the Bomb is QCF QCF + P or QCF QCF + K. Throw is forward or back + LP+MP, like the rest of the CVS cast. His command grab always connects with the bat too, and its bat and hockey stick finishers knock the opponent into the TagWars wall bounce. The hockey puck stays on the floor a second longer and can still be hit again while it lies there. He can attack out of a forward air dash, and his super jump has the same trail, burst and sound as everyone else's.
New: Casey Jones joins the MVC roster too, next to Raphael. MVC Casey has chain combos on the ground and in the air, with a cr.HP launcher (hold Up after it hits to super jump after them). Specials: LP/LK = light, MP/MK = hard, HP/HK = EX version (1/2 bar). Bronx Uprising (DP + P) also works in the air, and air normals cancel into it. Super Drop the Bomb is QCF + LP+MP or QCF + LK+MK. Throw is forward or back + LP+LK.
Change: Sentinel (MvCX) is removed from the MVC roster (SentinelXvsSF is still there).

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-05 1619
updates.notes:
Change: VS screen - the 1st fighter of each team now stands in front of the 2nd, and the 3rd stands at the back.
Fix: Casey Jones - a puck or baseball now stays on the ground for 1 second and can be hit the whole time, so crouching HK now hits a grounded baseball
Change: Casey Jones - forward + HP is now the long stick or bat swing, HP alone is the short swing
Fix: Casey Jones - EX Drop it! now gives him the crowbar with its own look (it showed the bat before)
Fix: Casey Jones - hitting a puck, baseball or other item now follows the hitboxes, so swings that visibly touch it connect
Change: Casey Jones (MVC) - crouching HP launcher no longer knocks down; the opponent has 40 frames of air hitstun, then can recover (stops a corner loop)
New: Button hints now show the icons of the controller you used last - Xbox, PlayStation, Switch or your keyboard keys - on the menus, select, VS, lobby, tournament and ranking screens and in the pop-ups
New: Command List - the button icons follow your controller and your own button setup (remap LP and the list shows the new button)
Change: Select screen - P2 can now use the holds too: Start (Match Settings), Y (Side Select), RT (Profile), RB (Joystick Config) and B (Leave)
New: Replays screen remade - replays grouped by day with both players' names, and a card with the stage, both teams, the score, mode and length. Y deletes a replay (asks first). Teams, stage and score are saved for new online matches only
New: AI vs AI - the select screen now lets you pick Single, Tag or Turns for each side (other modes stay Tag only)
New: Tournament - new Team Mode rule: Single, Tag or Turns (2 characters) for the whole tournament
Fix: CVS - Down + LT now does only the Custom Combo / MAX Mode; it no longer starts Variable Cross too (LT alone still does)
Change: CVS - Custom Combo and MAX Mode no longer bring up the Super background
Change: Shun'Ei (CVS) - Demolish Dimension (level 3) now also comes out with D, F, D, F + LP+LK or HP, like the other level 3 supers
New: Shun'Ei (CVS) - EX version of his F, DF, F upper (any two punches)
Fix: Shun'Ei (CVS) - no longer starts round 1 with a free bar of meter

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-05 1623
updates.notes: Fix: Shun'Ei (CVS) - Rush Impact, Combo Breaker (ground and air), Aerial Rave and his assist now use the right moves

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-05 1930
updates.notes:
New: Casey Jones (CVS) - dodge and rolls: LP+LK to dodge, hold forward or back to roll
Changed: CVS - dodges, rolls and back rolls now cost 1/3 of the Stamina (guard) bar; with 1/3 or less left they don't come out
Fixed: Saiki (CVS) - QCF+K and DP+K can now be special-cancelled in Hyper Drive and with Drive Cancel
Fixed: Hyper Drive - many characters could still cancel specials into supers at any time; supers now only cancel in its last 2 seconds, for everyone
Changed: Saiki (CVS) - QCF+MK launcher drops the opponent faster each time it's used in the same combo and does less damage (down to 40%) (resets when the combo ends)
Changed: Shun'Ei (CVS) - new assist move (Phantom); one of his specials does less chip damage and holds the opponent a little longer on hit

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-06 2130
updates.notes:
New: Pilot Wings is now a transition stage (offline). Knock someone off the right side and they get sent flying over the ocean, smashed through the mountains and into Derelict Church; off the left side, into Wilderness Within.
New: Vineswept Market, Derelict Church, Wilderness Within, Daoban Temple and Keepers of Immortal Dreams are now linked transition stages (offline), in that order left to right. Break a wall to send your opponent into the next stage.
Removed: 13 MVC stages and their songs - Memoria - Ocean, Memoria - World Fusion, Rarity's Pull, Ultimecia Castle - Bridge, Clock Tower, Dragoon Cavern, Egyptian Valley, Genosha Wilds, Kinder Gym, Knowhere, Otherworld Invasion, Spencer Mansion and INDIAXIII-TWS. The CVS versions of these stages are unchanged.
New: Unknown - Gill now has a breakable stone floor (offline). Slam your opponent into the floor 3 times and it caves in, dropping the fight through the sky into Mediterranean Sea - Gill.
New: Unknown - Gill also leads up to Hidden Shrine - Gill (offline), the same way SF vs MK goes up to its 2nd floor. Launch your opponent high and the stage fades to black as they fly up and crash through to the Shrine, once a match. Break the Shrine floor to fall back down to Unknown - Gill.
Fix: Chronos with your partner KO'd (Tag while getting hit) could leave you invincible for a long time, blinking or not. The invincibility now lasts 1 second at most.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-06 2350
updates.notes:
Fix: CVS Captain Commando's Captain Shoot could juggle forever. Each Captain Shoot in the same combo now makes the opponent fall faster and does 20% less damage (down to 40%).
Fix: CVS Casey's Harlem Wind-Up with the bat: the first swing now holds the opponent like the stick, so the second swing connects.
Fix: CVS Casey's Harlem Wind-Up with the crowbar could leave Casey swinging forever (opponent stuck on the wall, or landing before reaching it). Fixed.
Change: CVS Maylee: new CPU moves, new move, and hitbox adjustments.
Change: CVS Rozwel and Shun'Ei: move adjustments.

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-07 1327
updates.notes: Fix: Online, players could show as on another X2 update for 1-3 minutes after starting the game while the game files were being checked. The check now remembers your files and only re-checks changed ones, so it is ready in a second (the first start after this update still takes one full check).

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-07 1430
updates.notes:
Change: CVS Custom Combo, MAX Mode and Excel Combo now use the Street Fighter Alpha 2 input for every CVS character: any 2 punches + a kick, or any 2 kicks + a punch (was Down + LT, or HP+HK / LT / LP+MP+HP on some characters)
Change: Power Charge is now MP+MK for every CVS character (Hayato, Nrvnqsr, Roa, Warachia, KAGE, Rockman Zero, Gallon and Bluestreak used other buttons)
Change: CVS Vice takes a bit more damage while falling or juggled (fall defence 50 to 40), and the neutral jump was adjusted

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-07 2315
updates.notes:
Change: Snapback can now be done straight out of a run or dash, the same way normals can cancel a run
New: Yoko is back on the CVS roster - grabs, supers and command list set to CVS standards
Fix: CVS Captain America's shield effects no longer stay on screen when you Rush Cancel his shield charge special or his shield supers

updates.name: X2 Update 2026-11-10 1859
updates.notes:
Fix: CVS rolls and dodges no longer come out when you don't have enough Guard bar left (mashing the roll could slip past the check)
New: SFV Gill joins the MVC roster
Change: SFV Gill always starts with both V-Skills and V-Trigger 1 & 2 together (no more picking at the start of the match)
Change: SFV Gill's V-Gauge, CA bars and the SKILL/TRIGGER labels are hidden (X2 uses the normal power bar)
Change: SFV Gill's combo scaling is gentler - damage now stops dropping at 50% instead of 10% in long combos
New: SFV Gill has a full Command List in the pause menu (V-Skills, V-Triggers, launcher and supers with his X2 inputs)
Change: Chhritos and Alexius sprite files are much smaller on disk, they look and play the same
Change: SFV Urien's jumping HK now lets an airborne opponent fall and knocks down
